ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 9:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) internal pixels to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) perimeter and focal spot pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominantly white background field. Contiguous low-intensity blobs (black/dark grey) observed: three distinct spots on the mid-left lobe, one vertical smudge centered below the median notch, and several smaller punctate spots scattered on the mid-to-lower right lobe. High-intensity pixels define the core lobe areas, bounded by a dark trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an internal pixel angle measured at approximately 42 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge boundary. Amplitude of variations ranges from 5 to 15 pixels. Sharpest peaks are located on the outer distal margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a generally convex curve from the notch to the lobe tips, with the sweep of the left lobe appearing slightly more elongated than the right.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, roughly circular pixel clusters detected: three on the left lobe (medial-lateral distribution) and two smaller clusters on the lower-right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, high-contrast dark linear stroke is visible on the far-left lobe near the top edge, angled at approximately 30 degrees relative to the horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical dark smudge/scar is visible immediately below the median notch. The trailing edge displays significant irregular jaggedness consistent with physical wear or historical mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'ink-blot' style vertical mark at the notch paired with sparse, high-contrast freckling on an otherwise white ventral field.
